description: Fresh EN field geology holdout domain with ES/EN questions.

units.title: Strike and dip
units.text: Strike and dip measurements describe the orientation of a planar geological feature in the field and are recorded together with the observation location.

units.title: Sample label
units.text: Each collected sample receives an identifier that links the specimen bag to its field note and recorded location before the team leaves the sampling point.

units.title: Loose rock face
units.text: Before working beneath a fractured exposure, the team assesses loose material and chooses a safe position rather than beginning hammer work directly below unstable rock.

units.title: Fresh surface
units.text: A fresh broken surface can reveal minerals obscured by weathering, but one fresh surface does not demonstrate that the entire outcrop is unweathered.

units.title: Field photograph
units.text: A field photograph includes scale and location context when practical so the image can be interpreted together with the written observation.

units.title: Mapped contact
units.text: A mapped contact records where two geological units meet and notes whether the boundary was directly observed or inferred between exposures.
